FOMO is about turning passive holders into active community members.

The opportunity isn't simply in getting people to buy a meme. It's in creating a culture where people want to participate in keeping that meme alive.

Price appreciation is never guaranteed, and community effort alone cannot manufacture sustainable demand.

But if attention is one of the most valuable resources in the memecoin economy, then a meme that encourages genuine participation has a compelling cultural foundation.

Everyone wants their bags to go up. José understands that a community doesn't build itself.
